subject: Mutual availability matrix — schedule 30m walkthrough
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@brightgrid.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual availability matrix — schedule 30m walkthrough

Hi Claire / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about BrightGrid's ingestion bottlenecks and the latency targets you're shooting for on inference. Quick recap so we're aligned:

- Current pain: long tail inference latency during spike windows (~95th pct > 1.2s).
- Success metric: reduce 95th pct latency by 30% while keeping unit cost +/-10%.
- Priority: P1 is reliability across sudden batch traffic; P2 is cost predictability for monthly forecasting.

Next best step: a focused 30-minute product walkthrough where we can show the runtime behavior on a representative trace and discuss integration/ops. Can you please pick one of the three time brackets below (all times in PDT):

Option A — Wed Oct 1, 9:30–10:00 AM PDT
Option B — Thu Oct 2, 1:00–1:30 PM PDT
Option C — Fri Oct 3, 11:00–11:30 AM PDT

If none of the above work, I've attached a tiny mutual_availability_matrix.xlsx — feel free to add your team's preferred bands and we'll lock a slot.

I'll loop in Priyom (solutions engineer) and Grace (customer success) on the call so we can cover infra and onboarding questions.

Attachments: mutual_availability_matrix.xlsx (fillable), precall_checklist.pdf (short list of useful artifacts: example trace, QPS targets, security contact).

Thanks — I can be flexible on the options above, just let me know which you prefer.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@brightgrid.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Mutual availability matrix — schedule 30m walkthrough

Thanks, Karthik — and thanks for the helpful recap.

Option A (Wed Oct 1, 9:30–10:00 AM PDT) works best for us — that maps to 12:30–1:00 PM our time here on the East Coast. We'll plan for a short demo and an infra Q&A.

Couple of quick asks:
- Can we highlight how Redwood handles KV cache eviction under bursty patterns? That's an area our infra lead (Samir) will want to see.
- We'll also invite our security lead (Ishan Kumar) to sit in; he's included on the calendar invite below.
